title: Choose Lean — Figure variations
question: Figure (rear-view rider) is the shortlist. Three similar compositions: same rider, different hierarchy.

options.label: Fill
options.thesis: The rider fills the glass. 32° is a small orange TV bug on the body. Steer lives on the orange bars.
options.viewport: Square plaque. White rear-view MX rider fills it, leaned 32°. Small orange 32° bug on the hip. Handlebar is orange and turned. No bottom hairline.
options.risk: The number can get lost on the figure at race speed.

options.label: Callout
options.thesis: Huge 32° on the left, rider on the right. The number is the glance; the rider proves it.
options.viewport: Wide plaque. Left 45%: huge orange 32°. Right 55%: white rear-view rider leaned 32°. Steer 30% as a hairline under the rider.
options.risk: Can read as a stats card with a sticker if the rider shrinks too far.

options.label: Crop
options.thesis: Helmet, bars, shoulders. A tight rear crop so the lean is a body, not a tiny toy in a box.
options.viewport: Square plaque. Tight crop from helmet through handlebars and shoulders, leaned 32°. Orange 32° sits under the helmet like a nameplate. Bars orange for steer.
options.risk: Without boots/wheels it may not read as a bike at a glance.
